C09 desc.paragraph: Front-of-house trolleys for beverages, desserts and flambé service — built to perform and designed to impress.

style.C09 FOH Trolleys: background: #FFFFFF; padding: 110px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); gap: 88px; align-items: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; scroll-margin-top: 170px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 88px 40px; gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 64px 20px; gap: 36px; scroll-margin-top: 150px; }
style.C09 ring: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; top: -140px; left: -200px; width: 420px; height: 420px; min-width: 420px; border-width: 1.1px; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.3); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.C09 mosaic: flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; padding: 0px; width: 660px; min-width: 660px; flex-shrink: 0; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; order: -1; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; order: -1; gap: 12px; }
style.C09 main wrap: position: relative; padding: 0px; width: 100%; height: 420px; overflow: hidden; @media(--mobile){ height: 240px; }
style.C09 main image: display: block; width: 100%; height: 420px; object-fit: cover; @media(--mobile){ height: 240px; }
style.C09 tag: position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: auto; padding: 12px 18px; background: #071F44; z-index: 2;
style.C09 tag text: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.2; color: #E2BB6C;
style.C09 thumb 1: display: block; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; width: 50%; height: 240px; object-fit: cover; @media(--mobile){ height: 150px; }
style.C09 thumb 2: display: block; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; width: 50%; height: 240px; object-fit: cover; @media(--mobile){ height: 150px; }
style.C09 details: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; align-items: flex-start; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; gap: 20px; }
style.C09 label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.C09 rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.C09 label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E; line-height: 1.2;
style.C09 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 58px; line-height: 60px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #0B2F62; width: 100%; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 50px; line-height: 54px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.C09 desc: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px; color: #5F6675; width: 100%; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
style.C09 specs: padding: 24px 0px; gap: 32px; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%; border-width: 1px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: #E6E0D6; @media(--mobile){ gap: 16px; padding: 20px 0px; }
style.C09 range: flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; align-items: flex-start;
style.C09 range title: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; line-height: 1.2; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; }
style.C09 range 1: padding: 0px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; width: 100%; @media(--mobile){ gap: 8px; }
style.C09 range 1 dash: width: 10px; min-width: 10px; height: 1.5px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.C09 range 1 text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: #16213A; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; }

style.C09 brand 1: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; color: #0B2F62; background: #F7F4EE; padding: 8px 14px;
style.C09 actions: padding: 8px 0px 0px 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ gap: 10px; width: 100%; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
style.C09 quote: @media(--mobile){ padding: 15px 12px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; flex: 1 1 auto; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
